AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. When learning Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircraft Tools and Materials 2.3 Aircraft Related Drawin, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircraft Tools and Materials 2.3 Aircraft Related Drawin.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircraft Tools and Materials 2.3 Aircraft Related Drawin.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircraft Tools and Materials 2.3 Aircraft Related Drawin.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircraft Tools and Materials 2.3 Aircraft Related Drawin.

4. When learning Safety in the Aviation Workplace, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Safety in the Aviation Workplace.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Safety in the Aviation Workplace.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Safety in the Aviation Workplace.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Safety in the Aviation Workplace.

5. When learning Airport Safety 2.0 Aircraft Basic Construction 2.1 Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircr, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Airport Safety 2.0 Aircraft Basic Construction 2.1 Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircr.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Airport Safety 2.0 Aircraft Basic Construction 2.1 Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircr.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airport Safety 2.0 Aircraft Basic Construction 2.1 Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircr.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Airport Safety 2.0 Aircraft Basic Construction 2.1 Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircr.

6. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing 3.0 Flight Operations 3.1 Aviation W, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing 3.0 Flight Operations 3.1 Aviation W.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing 3.0 Flight Operations 3.1 Aviation W.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing 3.0 Flight Operations 3.1 Aviation W.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing 3.0 Flight Operations 3.1 Aviation W.

7. When learning Airport Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airport Safety.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Airport Safety.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Airport Safety.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Airport Safety.

8. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

9. When learning Introduction to Aviation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Aviation.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Aviation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Aviation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Aviation.

10. When learning Aircraft Tools and Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Tools and Materials.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Tools and Materials.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Tools and Materials.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Tools and Materials.

11. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing.

12. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Keyboard

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Aerodynamics of Flight and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The Airport 4.2 Airport Business Services Page 15 of 52 1 STRAND 1.0: FOUNDATION and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The Airport and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Airport Business Services and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. D — Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircraft Tools and Materials 2.3 Aircraft Related Drawin.

4. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Safety in the Aviation Workplace.

5. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airport Safety 2.0 Aircraft Basic Construction 2.1 Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircr.

6. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing 3.0 Flight Operations 3.1 Aviation W.

8. A — Information and Communication Technology

9. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Aviation.

10. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Tools and Materials.
